svg.title: Kanji Masta mobile-first Admin shell
svg.desc: Dark mobile mockups for Admin cost and invite management plus a desktop viewport showing the same narrow centered application shell.
svg.text: Admin — one mobile shell at every viewport
Costs and invites use the main app's narrow column, card lists, bottom navigation, and 44 px minimum controls.
Dialogs become reachable bottom sheets; wide tables become stacked cards; the information hierarchy does not change at desktop width.
Give one person access to Shuukan.
Desktop adds breathing room around the app, not a second layout inside it.
Layout contract: one narrow route shell, bottom navigation inside that shell, stacked information cards, and bottom sheets for focused actions. Desktop retains the same reading and interaction order.
